title: The query log's tests are one end-to-end run and its format and privacy guards
goal: The query log's 13 test files (test_querylog_e2e.py, test_ql_store/capture/distill/deliver/learn/research/report/export.py, test_kbusage.py, test_worker_capture.py, test_kbotel.py, test_usage_routing_docs.py) hold only the 35 tests the notes' KEEP list names (1,320 ids on 2026-10-05; test_redact.py's 11 stay whole), every removed id is in _tools/test_ids_dropped.txt under a reason line that names the operator's direction of 2026-10-05 and the kept test of its file that still reaches the module, conftest.SCOPE_GROUPS names only classes that exist, and every tool module is still reached by a test; a full tests.py spends about 650 worker-seconds less (about 1.5 min of wall on macOS at 7 workers, about 7 min on the Windows host). It no longer catches: the e2e scenarios of fixes, research, conflicts, two clones, CI states and sessions; the planted matrices of every sidecar field and spool shape; the job-state table; distill's and the launcher's edge cases. Those show in the ops rows, querylog.py digest and the gate's querylog.py check.
notes: KEEP, test_ names without the prefix, [1] the first case (all else in these files goes): querylog_e2e: TestModesAuto's modes, a_leak_in_a_run_file_blocks_the_push; ql_store: golden_passes_and_check_reports, identifier_gate[1], free_text_gate[1], the_spool_and_local_store_stay_ignored, work_sidecar_planted[1], overhead_sidecar_planted[1], ops_sidecar_planted[1], ops_sidecar_refuses_free_text, work_rework_planted[1]; ql_capture: bad_input_never_fails, fetch_rows_keep_host_and_path_only, ops_call_tool_no_command_text, off_or_unreadable_config_writes_nothing[1], pipeline_claude_runs_carry_disable_all_hooks; ql_distill: golden_run_file, nothing_raw_in_the_run_file, the_entry_holds_the_kb_question_not_the_prompt, the_launcher_returns_in_budget_and_its_child_outlives_it; ql_deliver: local_never_pushes_and_deletes_the_rows_at_once, the_leak_scan_over_store_files, applied_with_stub_gates_then_converges, a_fix_that_fails_the_gates_is_put_back, gate_jobs_decide[1]; ql_learn: two_runs_on_the_same_store_and_head_give_identical_files; ql_research: at_most_the_daily_runs, a_red_check_puts_everything_back; ql_report: two_copies_of_one_store_give_identical_output, the_hook_command_prints_at_most_one_json_line_and_exits_0; ql_export: ops_export_redacts_at_read; kbusage: no_text_of_the_transcript, planted[1]; worker_capture: worker_usage_routing_by_worktree_path[1]; kbotel: otel_events_no_text_stored. Whole file goes: usage_routing_docs. Premise: pytest --collect-only -q over the 13 files collects 1,320 (7fbf1f2d5). Measured on macOS, one process: e2e 380 s (kept TestModesAuto 8 s), ql_deliver 143, ql_store 95. The checks pass before the work (no id unlisted, no module unreached). No gate: test files and reasons only, under the operator's settled direction.
